newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee mostly lower, differentials cut.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee mostly lower, differentials cut.

text.p: Most Bremen cash coffee prices eased as origin sellers reduced differentials, traders reported on Friday.
Lower prices also resulted from futures reductions this week although both London and New York were last headed higher.
Buyers said they had received Centralamerican and Colombian sales offers from the 97/98 crops and taken advantage of lower prices, which were off by $8 to $24 per 50 kg fob on the week.
But Brazils remained at $180, basis July/August shipment second hand due to the firm domestic market and Kenyans at $370 due to tight supply. Sumatran robustas were offered at $84 cif.
